title: Admidio from 5.0.16 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with folder…
description: Admidio versions from 5.0.16 up to but not including 5.0.18 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows users with folder upload permissions to upload SVG files containing malicious JavaScript. These scripts execute in the context of the Admidio origin when the SVG is served inline by the downloadFile() function without appropriate security headers like nosniff or Content Security Policy (CSP). This can affect all viewers of the SVG, including unauthenticated visitors.
